description.title: The Tern Isles
description.premise: A new trainer leaves Tern Harbour with a first Pokemon, to earn the badges of the isles.
description.backdrop: Small green islands lie in a warm sea, and ferries join them. People live, work and battle beside Pokemon. Every island has a Pokemon Center, a shop and a gym.
description.scope: Play runs island by island, until Team Undertow falls.

harbour-road.name: The Harbour Road
harbour-road.brief: A grassy road above the ferry dock
harbour-road.description: Tall grass grows beside a road that runs above the ferry dock.

tern-harbour.name: Tern Harbour
tern-harbour.description: A small town gathers around a ferry dock and a shop.

pokemon-center.name: The Pokemon Center
pokemon-center.brief: The healing house by the dock
pokemon-center.description: A calm building where Nurse Wren heals every Pokemon for free.

tern-gym.name: Tern Gym
tern-gym.description: A stone gym that opens its door at the evening tide.

gull-cove.name: Gull Cove
gull-cove.brief: A rocky cove past the tree line
gull-cove.description: A rocky cove where the waves break on dark stones.

mira.name: Professor Mira
mira.brief: The professor who gave the player a first Pokemon.

rook.name: Rook
rook.brief: A camper who battles every new trainer on this road.

wren.name: Nurse Wren
wren.brief: The nurse of the Pokemon Center.

ines.name: Captain Ines
ines.brief: The gym leader of Tern Gym.
ines.style: sets up behind her Horsea, then sweeps with Staryu
ines.win_line: The tide turns for everyone. Come back when you can ride it.
ines.lose_line: You rode the tide well. The Tide Badge is yours.

tamsin.name: Tamsin
tamsin.brief: A trainer from Tern Harbour who got a first Pokemon on the same day as the player: the player's rival.
tamsin.style: attacks from the first turn and never switches out
tamsin.win_line: Ha! Told you I'd win. Try to keep up.
tamsin.lose_line: Fine, you win this one. I'll be stronger next time.

vesper.name: Admin Vesper
vesper.brief: An admin of Team Undertow, who leads the grunts at Gull Cove.
vesper.style: poisons first, then waits behind Grimer's bulk
vesper.win_line: The tide belongs to Team Undertow. Stay out of the water, child.
vesper.lose_line: A setback. The boss will hear of you, and so will the sea.

opening.arc: Captain Ines waits at the harbour gym, and Rook wants to beat the player first. Team Undertow works in secret at Gull Cove.

operation.goal: Grunts drain the tide pools of Gull Cove to open an old sea cave.

scheme.name: Team Undertow
scheme.goal: Wake Articuno in the sea caves under the isles and freeze the ferry lanes, so every island must pay Team Undertow to cross.
stages: Team Undertow opens the old sea caves that run under the isles.
Deep in the caves lies a frozen shrine, and a legendary bird sleeps in it.
Team Undertow means to wake Articuno and turn the sea lanes to ice.
The boss of Team Undertow waits in a lair under the last isle, ready to seize the ferries.
